ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface area, concentrated medially; high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) occupy approximately 25% localized at the lateral extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a solid low-intensity black contiguous area. Distinct mottled high-intensity regions are located at the lateral distal ends of both lobes, with a higher surface area of light pigment on the left lobe compared to the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a clear vertex; depth of the notch is approximately 10-15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across the trailing edge; individual peaks are sharp and distinct from the background pixel data.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature of the trailing edge originating from the median notch and terminating at upward-tilted lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel nodes (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible within the light-pigmented regions on the distal sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent calcified growths at the fluke tips and visible surface scarring in the form of rake marks on the pigmented sections.
